unit.why: A short anecdote about the Holy Jew of Przysucha, whose wife secretly builds him a house; it ends with his exegesis of Proverbs 19:14.

stories.start_quote: ידוע שדרכו בקודש של רבינו הקדוש
stories.summary_en: The Holy Jew of Przysucha gave away everything to charity, so his wife secretly took money and built him a house; when his disciples finally revealed it to him, he interpreted 'house and wealth are the inheritance of fathers, but a prudent wife is from the Lord'.
